_comment: Single source of truth for every product on the site. Editorial fields (name, category, blurb, alt, featured, order) are yours to edit by hand. The measured fields (image, width, height, aspectRatio, lqip) are filled in automatically by `npm run images:build` — do not edit those, they will be overwritten. Every blurb and alt line here describes only what is visible in the photograph; no flavour or ingredient has been assumed. See CONTENT-TODO.md.

products.name: Gold Leaf & Bears
products.blurb: Two tiers, gold leaf, a sphere cluster and two fondant bears.
products.alt: Two-tier ivory buttercream cake with flecks of gold leaf running diagonally, a cluster of gold, white and grey spheres up one side, dried palm leaves and two small fondant teddy bears.

products.name: Chocolate-Covered Strawberries
products.blurb: Whole strawberries dipped in chocolate, drizzled, packed by the tray.
products.alt: Two foil trays of whole strawberries dipped in dark and milk chocolate, each finished with a contrasting drizzle, on a kitchen counter beside a window.

products.name: Red Rose Two-Tier
products.blurb: Two white tiers, a gold leaf seam, fresh red roses.
products.alt: Two-tier white buttercream cake with a diagonal seam of gold leaf, topped and flanked with deep red roses and sprigs of baby's breath.

products.name: Blueberry Naked Layer
products.blurb: Bare-sided sponge, whipped cream, blueberries piled on top.
products.alt: Rustic bare-sided layer cake with the sponge and cream layers showing, thick whipped cream on top and a ring of fresh blueberries around a single candle.

products.name: Butterfly Two-Tier
products.blurb: White tiers, a climb of paper butterflies, gold wings and macarons.
products.alt: Two-tier white cake with pink and lavender butterflies climbing one side, large gold butterfly wings behind, a gold Happy Birthday topper and two macarons on the lower tier.

products.name: Strawberry & Blossom
products.blurb: Vertical piped buttercream, sliced strawberries and white blossom.
products.alt: Tall cake with vertical piped buttercream ridges flecked with pink, crowned with sliced strawberries and sprigs of small white blossom, lit by direct sunlight.

products.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
products.blurb: Thick, soft-centred cookies packed with chocolate chips.
products.alt: Six thick chocolate chip cookies piled on a white plate with a green floral rim.

products.name: Sprinkle Cake Pops
products.blurb: White chocolate shell, rainbow nonpareils, one bite each.
products.alt: A dozen cake pops coated in white chocolate and scattered with rainbow nonpareil sprinkles, standing on sticks in a white block.

products.name: Fruit & Cream Drip
products.blurb: A pale drip over cream, fresh fruit and chocolate rolls on top.
products.alt: Round cream-frosted cake with a pale yellow drip down the sides, topped with strawberries, blueberries, pineapple and kiwi and three chocolate cigar rolls.

products.name: Whipped Cream & Fruit
products.blurb: Whipped cream, piped rosettes, a ring of fresh fruit.
products.alt: Round whipped cream cake with piped rosettes and a ring of kiwi, strawberry and peach around the edge, and a birthday message written across the top in chocolate.

products.name: Oh Baby Ombré
products.blurb: Blue-to-cream ombré, sugar pearls, a piped crown and a small bear.
products.alt: Single-tier cake shading from pale blue at the top down to cream at the base, dotted with sugar pearls, with a piped blue crown, a fondant teddy bear and a glittered Oh Baby topper.

products.name: Fruit Ring
products.blurb: A full ring of kiwi, strawberry and pineapple on cream.
products.alt: Overhead view of a round cream-frosted cake edged with a ring of sliced kiwi, strawberries and pineapple alternating with piped cream rosettes.

products.name: Wrapped Cake Pops
products.blurb: Individually wrapped and gold-tied, ready to hand out.
products.alt: Cake pops in pink and white, each sealed in a clear cellophane bag tied with gold ribbon, standing upright on sticks in a white block.

products.name: Chocolate Overload
products.blurb: Dark ganache pooled on top, chocolate bars and Oreos stacked over.
products.alt: Cake with dark chocolate ganache pooled on top and dripping down white buttercream sides, loaded with Oreos, chocolate bars, malt balls and a striped wafer straw.

products.name: Building Block Birthday
products.blurb: Fondant bricks in seven colours, figurines and a number topper.
products.alt: Round cake covered in coloured fondant bricks with a child's name piped across the front, a number seven topper and small figurines arranged around the top edge.

products.name: Cookies & Cream Drip
products.blurb: Chocolate drip over buttercream, Oreos and white chocolate on top.
products.alt: Cake with a chocolate drip over pale buttercream, topped with Oreos and white and dark chocolate pieces, with chocolate chips pressed around the base.

products.name: Fresh Fruit & Cream
products.blurb: Cream-frosted, a piped shell border, a crown of fresh fruit.
products.alt: Round cream-frosted cake with a piped shell border around the base and a crown of sliced strawberries, kiwi and pineapple arranged on top.

products.name: Ruffle & Bloom
products.blurb: Combed buttercream, fresh pink blooms, a gold fan topper.
products.alt: Single-tier cake with vertically combed ivory buttercream, pink and white flowers up one side, a gold pleated fan topper and a small pink plaque, photographed outdoors.

products.name: Match Day
products.blurb: Green fondant pitch, fondant footballs and a number five.
products.alt: Round cake covered in green fondant with a pale drip down the sides, decorated with black and white fondant footballs, a number five medallion and a mirrored Happy Birthday topper.

products.name: Strawberries, From Above
products.blurb: Whole strawberries heaped on cream, ringed with white blossom.
products.alt: Overhead view of whole strawberries heaped on top of a white cake, surrounded by a ring of small white blossom.

products.name: BEARly Wait Two-Tier
products.blurb: Two white tiers, pastel spheres, macarons and a fondant bear.
products.alt: Two-tier white cake dotted with small gold stars, trimmed with pink, blue and gold spheres and macarons, with a fondant teddy bear seated on the lower tier and a gold baby shower topper on top.
